user.title: Klar NLU
user.description: This integration talks to Assist. A separate engine parses speech: the Klar NLU App, this bundled process, or Docker. On Home Assistant OS install the App as well, then pick Use the Klar NLU App. Without the App, pick Start the bundled engine. Do not run both. The release channel can be changed later.

init.title: Klar NLU
init.description: The personality is stored here, so it survives reinstalling the Klar app. Picking a personality copies its LLM refine prompt into this form.

data.refine_speech: Let the LLM refine NLU replies
data.assist_filter: Only control entities exposed to Assist
data.calendar_llm: Send calendar queries to the LLM

data_description.personality: Stored in this integration, not in the Klar app. Assist and the LLM voice follow the prompt.
data_description.refine_speech: Klar still controls devices. The fallback LLM then rewrites each finished reply.
data_description.refine_prompt: System prompt for the voice. No device control, no new facts, same language.
data_description.token: Same token as the Klar add-on.
data_description.assist_filter: On (default): only what Assist may see. Off: hidden entities too.
data_description.nlu_rag: Off by default. Chat and empty rejects send the matched slice to the fallback model.
data_description.quiet_ack: On simple light or switch on/off, skip the spoken reply and play a short chime.
data_description.calendar_llm: Off by default. On: Klar still reads the calendar, then the fallback LLM speaks the events. Off: Klar speaks the list itself. Create, delete, and move stay in Klar.
data_description.languages: Default follows the Home Assistant system language.
data_description.channel: Works anytime. Staging points at Klar NLU (Staging). Stable goes back to the app or bundled engine.
